title: Massey M-API Response Envelope
description: Common response envelope for the Massey University M-API v1. The service returns HTTP 200 for both success and failure; clients must read the 'status' boolean.

x-provenance.note: Failure shape observed live with no api key; success shape taken from the published documentation.

message.description: Error or status message. Empty string on success. Observed value on failure: 'Invalid api key'.
